title: INFO.DOC.-----AFL.DYM.------T.C.IMP.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 223 (T(IMP)M-21). INFO-DOC (information documentation) is the subject, with the (PO) prefix, "point of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. The title names AFL-DYM (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From AFL-DY: T-C-IMP. From TH-CONT: AFL-DY-INT.
